judge_panel.reason: The paper claims in Section IV that 'the estimator achieves multi-step performance statistically equivalent to a full-state oracle,' but the only statistical test reported (p=0.835) compares oracle action budgets, not learned-estimator vs. oracle performance. No p-value or equivalence test between the learned estimator and oracle is presented.

The paper claims the estimator achieves 'multi-step performance statistically equivalent to a full-state oracle,' but the only explicit hypothesis test reported is 'An independent t-test between nsamples = 200 and 2000 yields p = 0.835,' which compares oracle action-sampling budgets, not learned-vs-oracle performance or an equivalence test.

The conclusion claims the estimator achieves "multi-step performance statistically equivalent to a full-state oracle," but the paper fails to report the results of any statistical test (e.g., p-value) verifying this specific equivalence.
